    Privacy policy

    Last updated 12 October 2026

    On this page

    What we collectWhy we collect itHow long we keep itYour rights PrivacyTermsAccessibility

    This is a demonstration document for a fictional academy. The structure is real; the commitments are illustrative.

    What we collect

    An email address when you create an account or download a resource; course progress; and anonymous usage data. Nothing more.

    Why we collect it

    To run your account, keep your progress, and send the emails you asked for. We do not sell data, and we do not run third-party advertising trackers.

    How long we keep it

    Account data is kept while the account is open, then deleted within 30 days of closure. Analytics are aggregated after 14 months.

    Your rights

    Access, correction, export and deletion. Email privacy@webacademy.example and we will respond within 30 days.

    Web Academy NOVA

    Short lessons, real projects, and a mentor when you get stuck. A fictional academy used to demonstrate this template.
